info.name: Sidonpay API - End-to-End Tests
info.description:
Comprehensive end-to-end test collection for Sidonpay API platform.

## Setup Requirements

1. **Environment Variables**: Ensure these variables exist in your active environment:
   - `baseUrl` (e.g., https://sidonpay-be-2bnn.vercel.app)
   - `userId`, `userAccessToken`, `refreshToken`
   - `adminAccessToken`, `adminRefreshToken`, `challengeToken`, `adminCreationToken`
   - `accountId`, `favoriteId`, `billPaymentId`, `productId`, `purchaseId`
   - `cardId`, `notificationId`, `ticketId`, `adminId`, `kycId`, `transactionId`, `payoutId`

2. **Test Credentials**:
   - User: ada+test@sidonpay.com / Passw0rd!
   - Admin: sidonpayteam@gmail.com / Kehinde44% / 2FA: 63116133

3. **Authentication**: Collection-level Bearer Token authentication is configured to use {{userAccessToken}} by default. Admin folders override this with {{adminAccessToken}}. Public auth endpoints have "No Auth" configured.

4. **Test scripts** extract and save IDs/tokens from responses for request chaining.

## Usage

Run requests sequentially or use the Collection Runner. Start with Auth & OTP to obtain tokens, then proceed through other folders as needed.
